note: WON (F1 1.0 vs rg/ast-grep 0.80, embeddings 0.50). Three fixes: (1) php-analyzer extractMethods regex REQUIRED a visibility modifier, dropping bare `function persist()` (implicitly public) — made it optional, default public. (2) tree-sitter-parser parsePHPAST now captures the member-call RECEIVER (`$a` in `$a->save()`); previously only the containing class was recorded. (3) php-analyzer analyzeCallGraph: caller found by LINE RANGE (was wrongly keyed on the target method name); target resolves via buildPhpReceiverTypes (param `Account $a`, `$x=new T`) -> receiver type -> class -> method, with `$this`/self -> containing class and static `Foo::bar` via call.class. ast-grep arm also given `->` patterns so it competes at full strength.
